saying the opposite of what you mean, to be funny or unkind
vocabulary.example: 'Great weather!' she said with sarcasm, as it rained.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a group of things, e.g. flowers or bananas
vocabulary.example: He bought a bunch of flowers.

vocabulary.meaning_en: saying what will happen in the future
a hard block used to build walls
vocabulary.example: The house is made of red bricks.

vocabulary.meaning_en: how someone feels at a time
vocabulary.example: He's in a good mood today.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the feeling in a place or group
vocabulary.example: The atmosphere in the class was friendly.
My hair is messy this morning.

a person who follows someone on social media

the jobs you do in your working life

fine_lines.title: Thanks a bunch vs thank you
fine_lines.explanation_ar: thank you شكر صادق. أما thanks a bunch فكثيراً ما تُقال بسخرية لتعني العكس: أنا منزعج مما فعلت. نبرة الصوت والسياق يحددان المعنى.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Thank you' is real thanks. 'Thanks a bunch' is often sarcastic and means the opposite: I'm annoyed by what you did. Tone and context show the meaning.

examples.sentence: You ate the last biscuit? Thanks a bunch!
Thank you for helping me with my bags.

fine_lines.title: Famous last words vs it's now or never
fine_lines.explanation_ar: famous last words تُقال عن توقّع واثق تبيّن أنه خاطئ. it's now or never تعني أن الفرصة الآن فقط ويجب التصرّف فوراً.
fine_lines.explanation_en: 'Famous last words' is said about a confident prediction that turned out wrong. 'It's now or never' means you must act now or lose the chance.

examples.sentence: 'I won't get lost.' Famous last words - he got lost twice.
The sale ends today - it's now or never.

expressions.meaning_en: you must do it now, because you won't get another chance
expressions.example: The last train leaves in five minutes - it's now or never!

expressions.meaning_en: thank you - often said sarcastically when someone has annoyed you
expressions.example: You told everyone my surprise? Thanks a bunch!

expressions.meaning_en: said when a confident statement turns out to be wrong
expressions.example: 'It won't rain today.' Famous last words - we got soaked.

expressions.meaning_en: slowly and gradually, one part at a time
expressions.example: She built her business brick by brick.

expressions.meaning_en: to understand how people around you feel and act in the right way
expressions.example: He told jokes while everyone was sad - he didn't read the room.

expressions.meaning_ar: يوم سيئ (شعر غير مرتب / كل شيء خطأ)
expressions.meaning_en: a day when your hair looks messy, or when everything seems to go wrong
expressions.example: I overslept and missed the bus - it's a bad hair day.

expressions.meaning_en: used to introduce something surprising in a story
expressions.example: I was talking about Ahmed, and lo and behold, he walked in!

expressions.meaning_en: a person with many online followers who companies pay to promote products
expressions.example: The company paid a social media influencer to show its new shoes.

grammar.title: Sarcasm: saying the opposite
grammar.explanation_ar: السخرية هي أن تقول عكس ما تقصد بنبرة معينة. Thanks a bunch قد تعني 'شكراً' حقاً أو 'لقد أزعجتني'. انتبه للسياق: إذا فعل الشخص شيئاً سيئاً فالمقصود سخرية.
grammar.explanation_en: Sarcasm means saying the opposite of what you mean, with a special tone. 'Thanks a bunch' can be real thanks or mean 'you annoyed me'. Check the context: if the person did something bad, it's sarcastic.
examples: Thanks a bunch for the flowers! (real)
You broke my phone? Thanks a bunch! (sarcastic)
